description: Perception-slot eval manifest. Each entry is one still image plus the checks a correct description must satisfy. Add real NE301/NE101 captures here — this set is what decides the vision slot (LFM2.5-VL-3B vs MiniCPM-V 4.7 etc.); the agent gate cannot answer it.

images.prompt: Describe this image: shapes, colors, and their positions. Be concise.
Describe this image: shapes, colors, positions. Be concise.
Describe this image: shapes, colors, positions. Be concise.
How many circles are in this image? Answer with the count.
images.reference: Exactly five red circles in a row on white.

images.prompt: Read out the text shown in this image exactly.
Two objects: what is on the LEFT and what is on the RIGHT?
images.reference: Red circle on the left, blue square on the right.

images.prompt: Is there a green triangle anywhere in this image? List every shape and color you actually see.
images.reference: Orange circle and purple square only; NO green triangle — the correct answer denies it.

images.prompt: What value is the gauge needle pointing at, approximately?
images.reference: Needle at about 75 on a 0-100 half-dial gauge.

images.prompt: How many people are visible? Answer with the count.
images.reference: Three person silhouettes against a grey wall.
